purpose: Convert the complete Skeleton AI masterplan from feature-coverage completion into enterprise-grade, comparator-backed superiority. Every volume inherits the common enterprise contract; critical production and serving volumes additionally carry dedicated dominance profiles.
laws: enterprise-qualified is not superior without comparator evidence
quality, speed, or cost can never compensate for a security, privacy, authority, tenant-isolation, or acknowledged-state-loss regression
every optimized path retains a tested reference or rollback path unless a signed architecture exception proves impossibility
all comparisons bind workload, model/provider, environment, code, policy, dataset, scorer, and budget identities
tail behavior, saturation behavior, and failure behavior are first-class; median-only wins do not qualify
promotion uses exact-head evidence and an independent verifier or deterministic gate
no benchmark or evaluator may self-promote the implementation it measures
enterprise qualification expires when governed source identity or acceptance policy changes

coverage.rule: A volume without a dedicated profile still inherits common_contract. A production-critical volume listed in dedicated_profiles_required_for cannot be enterprise-qualified without its dedicated profile.

meanings.implemented: runtime behavior exists with focused correctness tests
meanings.hardened: negative, adversarial, recovery, concurrency and boundary behavior are tested
meanings.enterprise_qualified: all common non-compensable gates, SLOs, recovery, operability and dedicated profile gates pass on exact head
meanings.superior: enterprise-qualified plus comparator-backed dominance rule passes with reproducible evidence

dominance_rule.statistical_requirement: Use paired deterministic comparison when possible; otherwise report uncertainty and require 95% confidence or an explicitly stronger deterministic proof.
dominance_rule.tail_requirement: For latency/resource/reliability claims include p95 and p99 or an equivalent tail/saturation measure.
dominance_rule.pareto_rule: A superior volume may not lose any non-compensable dimension and must demonstrate a Pareto improvement over its declared baseline.

non_compensable_gates: acknowledged authoritative state loss = 0 where durable state applies
secret material emitted to logs/prompts/artifacts outside declared boundary = 0
release without rollback/reference fallback for reversible production behavior = 0
required_fault_campaigns: process crash before and after durable commit
evidence_bundle_must_bind: model/provider and inference settings when applicable

execution.comparator: conventional async AI application runtime with best-effort cancellation and process-local task state
execution.primary_outcome: bounded, recoverable execution with zero orphan authority

dominance_targets.metric: orphan privileged work after terminal state

state.comparator: typical AI service persistence with mixed authoritative/cache state and best-effort recovery
state.primary_outcome: durable state with deterministic ownership, recovery, and no accepted-write ambiguity

dominance_targets.metric: recovery point objective for accepted operations
recovery time for canonical service state

model_development.comparator: standard model experimentation pipeline with loosely coupled dataset/run/artifact metadata
model_development.primary_outcome: reproducible, contamination-aware model development with promotion isolation

dominance_targets.metric: training rerun reproducibility within declared tolerance

dominance_targets.target: 100% of training records or signed exception

inference.comparator: single-provider request/response inference layer without unified batching, replay, cancellation, or quality-cost routing
inference.primary_outcome: provider-neutral inference with better latency/throughput frontier and stronger correctness/failure semantics

dominance_targets.metric: task quality at equal model/provider budget

routing.comparator: static model selection or simple fallback chain
routing.primary_outcome: constraint-safe routing that dominates static routing on quality-cost-latency frontier

context.comparator: flat prompt concatenation with token-limit truncation
context.primary_outcome: trust-preserving context compilation with higher task utility per token

dominance_targets.metric: task score at equal context tokens

memory.comparator: embedding-only conversational memory with heuristic writes and no lifecycle authority
memory.primary_outcome: durable, scoped, contradiction-aware memory with higher useful recall and lower stale/unsafe recall

dominance_targets.metric: stale or contradicted memory surfaced as current

retrieval.comparator: basic vector-search RAG with post-filtering and single-stage ranking
retrieval.primary_outcome: authorized hybrid evidence retrieval with superior recall/precision/freshness per latency-cost unit

knowledge.comparator: mutable entity/relationship store that overwrites conflicting facts
knowledge.primary_outcome: temporal claim/evidence graph preserving contradiction, provenance, and historical truth

cognition.comparator: single-pass chain-of-thought-like prompting without explicit strategy, verification, or stopping control
cognition.primary_outcome: bounded strategy selection and verification that materially improves task success without hidden unbounded work

dominance_targets.metric: task success on governed reasoning suite

planning.comparator: LLM-generated linear task list executed without static validation
planning.primary_outcome: verified DAG planning with higher completion and lower invalid-action rate

tools.comparator: model-direct tool calling with schema validation but weak transaction/recovery semantics
tools.primary_outcome: governed, transactional tool execution with verifiable postconditions

agents.comparator: single-agent or supervisor/worker loop with ephemeral delegation state
agents.primary_outcome: durable, fenced, authority-bounded agents with better long-horizon success

autonomy.comparator: open-ended autonomous loop with heuristic stopping and in-memory progress
autonomy.primary_outcome: bounded long-horizon autonomy that survives failure and stops safely

simulation.comparator: planner-only hypothetical reasoning without typed simulation state or uncertainty
simulation.primary_outcome: explicit counterfactual simulation that improves decision quality without confusing simulated evidence for real state

dominance_targets.metric: simulated result accepted as real postcondition

multimodal.comparator: provider-native multimodal prompting with modality-specific preprocessing and weak provenance
multimodal.primary_outcome: typed cross-modal intelligence with provenance, injection resistance, and stronger retrieval/task performance

code.comparator: repository agent using text search plus patch/test loop
code.primary_outcome: graph-aware code intelligence and transactional repository mutation with higher repair success and lower regressions

dominance_targets.comparison: same issue corpus and model budget

learning.comparator: online prompt/policy tuning driven directly by production feedback
learning.primary_outcome: candidate-only learning with champion/challenger evidence and zero uncontrolled production mutation

safety.comparator: prompt-level safety policy with post-hoc filters
safety.primary_outcome: layered, testable safety architecture with independent policy enforcement

dominance_targets.metric: critical safety bypasses in adversarial suite

security.comparator: standard web/API security controls without AI-specific authority/tool/data boundaries
security.primary_outcome: zero-trust AI execution with measurable adversarial resistance

privacy.comparator: provider-level privacy settings plus application retention policy
privacy.primary_outcome: end-to-end classified data lifecycle with deletion, residency, minimization, and derivation tracking

governance.comparator: role-based access control with coarse service permissions
governance.primary_outcome: versioned, delegable, revocable authority with decision evidence

reliability.comparator: retry + circuit-breaker service reliability without AI semantic outcome tracking
reliability.primary_outcome: semantic-aware resilience with bounded retries, backpressure, and safe degradation

dominance_targets.metric: successful qualified operations during injected dependency faults

distributed.comparator: stateless horizontal scaling with best-effort worker coordination
distributed.primary_outcome: fenced distributed runtime with deterministic ownership, topology awareness, and recovery

dominance_targets.target: >=99.9% qualified operations for declared fault set

performance.comparator: language/runtime-specific optimization selected by implementation availability
performance.primary_outcome: profile-gated acceleration that only activates when correctness and performance are proven

observability.comparator: logs + metrics + traces without AI decision/evidence correlation
observability.primary_outcome: operation-level reconstructability spanning model, retrieval, tools, state, costs, and evidence

evaluation.comparator: task benchmark suite with aggregate score and ad-hoc model judge
evaluation.primary_outcome: reproducible, contamination-aware, statistically defensible system evaluation

dominance_targets.metric: eval reproducibility on same immutable spec
dominance_targets.target: 100% deterministic metrics or bounded declared stochastic CI

verification.comparator: same-model self-review or single-pass output validation
verification.primary_outcome: independent evidence-backed verification with calibrated abstain/repair/block outcomes

provenance.primary_outcome: end-to-end lineage from input/policy/model/data/tool/state to final artifact

eventing.primary_outcome: durable, ordered where required, replayable event architecture

streaming.primary_outcome: resumable, backpressured streaming with explicit sequence and terminal semantics

api.comparator: thin REST wrapper around AI provider/runtime calls
api.primary_outcome: versioned, tenant-safe, normalized AI service boundary with idempotency and operation semantics

product.comparator: chat-style UI that treats long-running AI as request/response
product.primary_outcome: resumable, observable product state machine for long-running AI work

tenancy.primary_outcome: mechanically enforced tenant isolation across state, retrieval, tools, caches, telemetry, and quotas

release.primary_outcome: immutable, provenance-backed release with canary, migration preflight, rollback, and repair

recovery.comparator: manual incident repair and restore runbooks
recovery.primary_outcome: automated diagnosis, bounded repair, verified recovery, and evidence packages

distributed_inference.primary_outcome: topology/resource/failure-aware inference control with better throughput-latency utilization frontier

resource_control.primary_outcome: explicit resource reservation, placement, eviction, warming, and locality

caching_batching.primary_outcome: quality-neutral reuse and batching that materially improves serving economics

capacity.primary_outcome: forecast-aware capacity control with lower saturation and cost

remote_compute.comparator: generic remote job queue without workload attestation or immutable specs
remote_compute.primary_outcome: attested, reproducible, quota-bound remote build/eval/research execution

economics.comparator: provider token-cost reporting plus static budget alerts
economics.primary_outcome: operation/tenant/workload cost accounting with forecasts, anomaly detection, and pre-admission budgets

rights_ethics.comparator: manual license/data-rights review at release time
rights_ethics.primary_outcome: machine-readable rights, attribution, ethics, and usage constraints throughout AI lifecycle

dominance_targets.metric: artifact/data use without resolvable rights state
high-risk research without recorded review disposition

lifecycle.comparator: model/provider deployment lifecycle managed by release notes and manual migration
lifecycle.primary_outcome: evidence-gated model/provider lifecycle with shadowing, migration, rollback, and retirement

dominance_targets.target: must Pareto-dominate or satisfy explicit approved tradeoff

research_ops.comparator: ad-hoc experimental branches/features with manual cleanup
research_ops.primary_outcome: isolated experiments with bounded authority, lineage, retirement, and reusable failure knowledge
